description: c's written [T [U]] reads the synthetic T, and its rest is the inner optional [U], which the restoration of U reads. A restoration reads a token, so the rest reads, and c is a second reading with V read as a bare terminal. The strict prediction of the rest must admit the empty production of [U], which reads in this mode (engine §7.4). Here c's inner [U] is predicted only strictly. A strict and an ordinary prediction of one helper at one position share their items, so a fault in the strict path shows only where that path is the only one, or comes first.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%elidable T U V W
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [T] [U] [V]
%rule b A [T] [U] [V] [W]
%rule c A [T [U]] V
